rule: The lipidomics route runs the in-memory lipid module (R/mod_lipidomics.R: import, design, qc, norm, de, summary) as shipped on kit_065; this map is KIT-068's reading of each step's kernel with line evidence. The units are determinations for KIT-031's declarations, not declarations: a row with a flag is a question the user answers before KIT-031 is authored; the ceiling() on the intensity filter's quantile is removed in KIT-031's declaration (user decision 2026-10-28) before any oracle is recorded. The normalisation tab's one action commits four states (ITSD, log2, between-sample, RUV-III), listed as sub-rows of the journey step `normalisation`. Every kernel loops over the assays (a list of wide tables, one per assay); a partitioned unit applies within one assay table and the declaration runs it projected (the `whole` variant) at these sizes. The DA output is the manifest lipid.da_results.v1 on the dia.da_results.v1 pattern (user confirmed 2026-10-29).

units.row: each row's result depends on that row only (given the design and any declared global statistics)
units.complete_sample: each sample column's result depends on that column only (given any declared global statistics)
units.feature_group: depends only on the rows of one feature group (the grouping column is named)
units.whole_matrix: uses a statistic or model over all rows and samples; runs once on one projected object under the cap
units.store: not a data kernel: import, design, session export
units.products: writes plots or tables only; commits no state

kernel_observations: Every numeric column of an assay table is taken as a sample column by the intensity filter and its quantile (R/func_lipid_s4_normalization_methods.R:931, R/func_lipid_qc.R:47): the design step must leave only the id, annotation and sample columns in each assay table for the quantile to be the intensities' quantile.

The internal-standard normalisation computes one aggregate standard signal per sample, then the mean of those aggregates over all samples, and scales each sample by mean / own aggregate (R/func_lipid_s4_normalization_methods.R:13-19 and the method body from :61): a complete-sample kernel with one dataset-wide statistic, not a per-standard-class model.

steps.label: Import
steps.module: R/mod_lipid_import_processing_helpers.R:620-730 (the process_import observer: assay list, sanitised names, validation, column mapping, import artefacts, workflow_data)
steps.evidence: R/func_lipid_import_readers.R:163-262: vroom read, column defaults by format (R/func_lipid_import_detection.R:221-290), sample columns = numeric columns not in the metadata list (:217-241), is_pattern from the format defaults (:258)
writes: workflow_data$assay_list, data_format, lipid_id_col, annotation_col, sample_columns, is_pattern
source_dir: import artefacts (assay_manifest.txt, column_mapping.json, the raw copies)
notes: route-specific row (two assays per upload; the vendor radio selects the reader)
no state: the module commits nothing until the design

steps.label: Design
steps.module: R/mod_lipid_design_builder_helpers.R:40-200 (save_results: data_cln per assay, design_matrix.tab, contrast_strings.tab, the S4 construction at :142, saveState lipid_raw_data_s4 at :167)
steps.evidence: R/mod_lipid_design_builder_helpers.R:142-170: lipid_data = results$data_cln, internal_standard_regex from col_map$is_pattern (:154-156); the builder's technical replicates and factors from the Assign Metadata and Technical Replicates tabs (R/mod_lipid_design_builder_action_helpers.R)
notes: route-specific row
the design import modal (design-show_import_modal / confirm_import) reads a directory of the builder's own artefacts; the kit drives the builder

steps.label: Intensity Filter
steps.evidence: R/func_lipid_s4_normalization_methods.R:931-952: per assay, sample_cols = numeric columns; min threshold = ceiling(quantile(all intensities of the assay, intensity_cutoff_percentile / 100)); R/func_lipid_qc.R:59-73: per row, the count of samples below the threshold / the number of samples, kept when the proportion < proportion_of_samples_below_cutoff (strict)
global_statistics: per assay: the quantile of all sample intensities at intensity_cutoff_percentile (the pre-pass); ceiling() applied at :949 today, removed in KIT-031's declaration (user decision 2026-10-28)
reads_outside_assay: project_dirs / omic_type / experiment_label read by the plot writer (R/func_lipid_qc_filtering_helpers.R:264-306; KIT-030)
steps.flag: confirm: row unit after the per-assay quantile pre-pass (one global statistic per assay), with ceiling() removed in the declaration; and confirm that the design's data_cln tables carry only the id, annotation and sample columns (every numeric column is a sample to this kernel: kernel_observations[1]), else the declaration must name the sample columns explicitly
notes: the NA handling is na.rm on the below-threshold count (R/func_lipid_qc.R:65): an NA is not below
the proportion rule is strict (<), as the DIA intensity filter's is

steps.label: Duplicate Resolution
steps.module: R/mod_lipid_qc_duplicates_server_helpers.R:437-480 (resolve_duplicates observer; the detection at :341-352 is products only; saveState lipid_duplicates_resolved at :285)
steps.evidence: R/func_lipid_qc_support_helpers.R:31-37: identity when no id repeats; :43-57: per id, keep the row with the highest mean over the sample columns (slice_max, with_ties = FALSE)
notes: grouping column: the lipid id column (LipidName on the LipidSearch layout)
the detect action (findDuplicateFeatureIDs, R/func_omics_qc_shared.R:60) commits nothing: a product of the same step

steps.label: Internal Standards (QC tab)
steps.kernel: inline: CV per standard over samples (R/func_lipid_qc_reporting_helpers.R:173-230)
steps.evidence: R/mod_lipid_qc_itsd.R:236-244: the regex from the input, else the object's internal_standard_regex
writes: plots (cv_plot, intensity_plot) and the is_results text
notes: not a journey step: no state; listed so the tab is accounted for

steps.label: Finalize QC
steps.kernel: none (validation of the current object; the state is a named commit of the current object)
notes: a store step: the same object under a new name

steps.label: Normalisation (the tab's one action)
steps.module: R/mod_lipid_norm_workflow_helpers.R:20-315 (run_normalization observer: pre-normalisation plots, ITSD, log2, post-normalisation plots, RUV-III, RUV plots, the composite figure)
steps.kernel: four kernels in sequence (sub-rows normalisation.itsd, normalisation.log2, normalisation.between, normalisation.ruv)
writes: states lipid_itsd_norm (when apply_itsd), lipid_log2, lipid_normalized, lipid_ruv_corrected (unless ruv_mode = skip)
qc_dir: pre/post/RUV plots per assay and the composite figure
holders: normData$post_filter_obj, post_itsd_obj, post_log2_obj, post_norm_obj, ruv_corrected_obj, ruv_optimization_results (whole objects; KIT-030 holders to references)
notes: one GUI action, four declared operations: KIT-031 declares each and the module requests them in sequence

steps.label: Internal-standard normalisation
steps.evidence: R/func_lipid_s4_normalization_methods.R:95-115: standards found by the object's internal_standard_regex on the annotation column (default itsd_pattern_columns) or the manual itsd_feature_ids; :13-19 (and the body): per sample the aggregate (sum, mean or median) of the standards, the mean of the aggregates over all samples, factor = mean / sample aggregate, every non-standard value scaled by the factor; standards removed after (remove_itsd_after_norm = TRUE)
global_statistics: per assay: the mean over samples of the per-sample aggregate standard signal (the pre-pass)
steps.flag: confirm: complete sample with the mean-factor pre-pass (kernel_observations[2]); the standards' row removal belongs to the same operation
notes: resolves KIT-031's pre-recorded 'per sample and per standard class' gap by reading: the existing units cover it
skipped when apply_itsd is off (the e2e lanes); the kit's lifecycle members run it

steps.label: Log2 transformation
steps.evidence: log2(x + offset) per value, offset from the tab (log_offset); no statistic over rows or samples
notes: elementwise: row is the narrowest unit the kit names

steps.label: Between-sample normalisation
steps.evidence: cyclic loess, quantile or scale over the whole assay matrix; `none` is the identity (the state is still committed)
notes: the DIA step map's determination for the same limma call

steps.label: RUV-III
steps.module: R/mod_lipid_norm_workflow_helpers.R:160-215 (sweep, best k, ruvIII_C_Varying; saveState lipid_ruv_corrected at :200)
steps.evidence: R/func_lipid_norm_ruv_optimization_helpers.R:94-120: the automatic sweep calls the negative-control ANOVA and the canonical correlation once per percentage on the whole object; the replicate structure comes from ruv_grouping_variable (group by default, R/func_lipid_s4_ruv_methods.R:34-72), not from the declared technical replicates
writes: product ruv_optimization_results (normData; exported by the session export)
notes: skipped when ruv_mode = skip (the e2e lanes): the journey's state is then lipid_normalized
the replicate rule (declared technical replicates vs the grouping variable) is the open KIT-035-style decision carried on the series plan, not a stage-3 flag

steps.label: Correlation Filtering
steps.evidence: R/mod_lipid_norm_workflow_helpers.R:672-682: per-pair Pearson within correlation_group = the tab's ruv_grouping_variable, then samples below min_pearson_correlation_threshold dropped; the input is the RUV-corrected object when RUV ran, else the normalised one (:665-669)
steps.flag: confirm: whole matrix, the DIA step map's determination for the same statistic (a sample's fate depends on every pair's correlation within its group)
notes: skip_correlation_filter commits lipid_norm_complete instead (R/mod_lipid_norm_workflow_helpers.R:588); the journey applies the filter

steps.label: Filtered session export
steps.evidence: writes lipid_filtered_session_data_<timestamp>.rds and _latest.rds (the object, the state names and history), lipid_ruv_optimization_results.RDS, lipid_itsd_selections.RDS, lipid_qc_params.RDS and the summary text under source_dir
writes: source_dir: the session RDS pair and its companions (KIT-071 owned exports)
notes: no state

steps.label: Differential abundance
steps.module: R/mod_lipid_da_server.R:27-60 (load_filtered_session, run_da_analysis), R/mod_lipid_da_session_helpers.R:221-330 (the Open: reads lipid_filtered_session_data_latest.rds and re-commits the session's current state name, :307-326), R/mod_lipid_da_analysis_helpers.R (the run), R/mod_lipid_da_export_helpers.R (the DA files)
steps.kernel: runLipidsDA (R/func_lipid_da_model.R:253-520; limma lmFit, contrasts, eBayes, treat per assay)
steps.evidence: R/func_lipid_da_model.R:253-330: the object's assays, design and contrasts; a plain list is returned (theObject, contrasts_results, da_lipids_long, per_assay_results, significant_counts, qvalue_warnings, thresholds); the GUI holds it in daData$da_results_list and never builds LipidomicsDifferentialAbundanceResults
